model_annotation: The chart illustrates the most important measures that enterprises consider can limit the "shadow economy" in the country. The vertical axis lists various measures, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage of respondents, ranging from 0% to an unspecified maximum value, with tick labels at every 2% or 5% interval, although the exact interval is not consistently marked. The bars are colored in red and blue, with no explicit legend provided, but the colors appear to be used consistently throughout the chart. The measures listed on the vertical axis include "Да се засили граничния контрол" (Strengthen border control) at 2%, "Да се ограничи действията на мафията" (Limit the mafia's actions) at 10%, "Да се облекчат условията за получаване на кредит" (Ease credit conditions) at 3%, "Да се намали корупцията" (Reduce corruption) at 13%, "Да се подобри качеството на административните..." (Improve the quality of administrative...) at an unspecified value, "Да се повиши ефективността на съдебната система" (Improve the effectiveness of the judicial system) at 9%, "Да се засили данъчния контрол" (Strengthen tax control) at an unspecified value, "Да се въведат по-ефективни стимули за бизнеса" (Introduce more effective business incentives) at an unspecified value, "Да се приемат по-строги закони" (Adopt stricter laws) at 5%, "Да се намалят акцизите" (Reduce excise taxes) at 2%, "Да се намали ДДС" (Reduce VAT) at 5%, "Да се намалят данъка върху печалбата" (Reduce profit tax) at 3%, and "Да се намали личния подоходен данък" (Reduce personal income tax) at 3%. The chart does not appear to be sorted in a specific order, and there is no clear visual emphasis on any particular bar. Overall, the chart presents a range of measures considered important by enterprises to limit the "shadow economy", with the most prominent being "Да се намали корупцията" (Reduce corruption) at 13%.
